findings.title: Identical keyframe body duplicated across two CSS modules
findings.description: The dotSpark and sparkle @keyframes blocks have byte-identical bodies (same 0/50/100% stops, same opacity/transform values). Any future tweak (e.g., adjusting scale range or easing) must be made in two places, and it is easy to drift. The project already keeps shared keyframes (objFloat, fadeUpC, trailFade) in globals.css, so the inconsistency is also a small cognitive tax.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) keep one shared keyframe 'sparkPulse' in globals.css and reference it via animation: :global(sparkPulse) ... in both modules (matches the existing precedent for objFloat/fadeUpC/trailFade), or (b) extract a tiny shared src/styles/animations.css. Option (a) is lowest-friction here.

findings.title: Mixed conventions for shared vs scoped keyframes create an implicit rule
findings.description: After this change, globals.css hosts some shared keyframes while two visually-identical sparkle keyframes live inside component modules. There is no documented rule for when a keyframe belongs in globals vs a module, so future contributors have no signal and may diverge further.
findings.recommendation: Add a one-line comment in globals.css stating the rule, or unify by moving the sparkle keyframe back to globals and referencing via :global().

residual_risks.title: Naming: dotSpark and sparkle describe mechanically identical animations
residual_risks.description: The names differ only because they live in different modules, not because the behavior differs. If they stay identical the divergent naming hides that fact; low impact on a personal site but worth noting.

residual_risks.title: :global(name) escape hatch trade-off
residual_risks.description: animation: :global(sparkPulse) ... is supported by Next.js css-loader and removes duplication, but reintroduces a cross-file name coupling (the original bug's shape). Acceptable for keyframe names since they are write-once and rarely renamed, unlike class names.

testing_gaps.title: No visual regression check for animations
testing_gaps.description: The original bug was a silent runtime failure that type-checking could not catch. A lightweight Playwright snapshot or manual QA checklist entry for 'stars pulse on load' would prevent recurrence if keyframes are renamed again.
